Author: Galderia
Name: BLUnion
Description: Compares learned Blue Mage spells across a party, shows where to find missing ones, and helps plan what to learn next together - multilingual (DE/EN/FR/JA), syncs via export/import codes or opt-in Live-Sync (optionally shares your online status with listed Group Finder entries). Clicking a location opens the Duty Finder (never queues) or teleports you once to the nearest aetheryte (one action per click, can be turned off) - no other gameplay automation.
